verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability pipeline captures call data (transcript, recording URL, metadata) as a CallLog and offers LiveKit SDK tracing, which covers inputs/outputs at a call level, but evidence never explicitly confirms per-LLM-call latency or token-usage capture. missing for 10: explicit documentation of latency metrics and token usage fields in the CallLog/trace schema, and independent confirmation of these fields being captured.
